body:
Founder real-time (remote control, continued): port BIG_O tech into SHANKPIT. Landed phase 4: packages/simulation/lab_sim.{h,c}, a verbatim port of BIG_O's cloning-facility equipment pipeline (centrifuge, PCR, sequencer, CRISPR splice bench, repressor install, breeding/genetic drift, embryo incubation). Deliberately kept plain C, not PARENA -- a real, checked judgment call (heavy expf/powf float math and RNG throughout, doesn't fit PARENA's scalar/no-RNG model), unlike phase 3's formulas. Verified with 7 tests covering every equipment function's real contract, a representative subset of BIG_O's own 17 -- found and fixed a real bug in this test's own first draft (genetic-drift-never-decreases check bred against a fixed low-drift partner, pulling the average down; fixed to match BIG_O's own real test methodology). Not yet wired into the live build (no consumer -- phases 6/7). SHANKPIT 4d5d1c2.

⚓ ☃
title: BIG_O engine merge phase 4: lab simulation
